messages: alex: heads-up — CI linkcheck failing on the mkdocs pipeline for the migration branch. build log shows a bunch of 404s for fragment links, eg. ../getting-started#model-selection ci-bot: build: docs/mkdocs: linkcheck failed (exit 2). see https://ci.redwood/example/3421 for details :warning: maya: ugh, this smells like heading slug differences after the mdx migration. any examples from the log? kevin: sample error from the log: ``` WARNING: broken link: ../guide/using-embed#best-practices -> ../guide/using-embed#best-practices (404) WARNING: broken link: ../guide/serving-models#quantize -> ../guide/serving-models#quantize (404) ``` alex: yeah — two patterns: 1) some headings lost hyphens vs spaces (slugify changed), 2) empty line between heading and first inline HTML/code fence makes the anchor generator drop the slug. seen this before with mkdocs+myst-mdx. jen: can we auto-fix? maybe run a quick script to add explicit header ids where ambiguous, e.g. `## Quantize model {#quantize}` or add HTML anchor `` above the heading. maya: I can whip up a small suggester that: - scans for headings without explicit ids - matches broken anchors from CI log - proposes targeted edits (only files referenced in failures) kevin: +1. prefer explicit ids where the heading text is non-ASCII or has inline code. less brittle. alex: ok, let's do a quickpatch PR rather than a bulk rewrite. target branch: docs/migration-fixes. small, reviewable. link to local repro steps in the PR body. maya: draft PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — it adds explicit ids for 8 headings and a short note in CONTRIBUTING about heading ids. ci-bot: note: re-running linkcheck on the PR will be blocked until changes are pushed to the branch. :info: jen: quick sanity test before pushing: run mkdocs locally and then the linkcheck plugin: ``` pip install -r requirements.txt mkdocs build mkdocs linkcheck --fail-on-broken ``` open http://localhost:8000 to eyeball anchor jumps. maya: pushed changes to the PR. also added a small Python helper `scripts/fix_heading_ids.py` that prints diffs so reviewers can eyeball. kevin: nice. small nit: prefer `{#my-id}` syntax for mkdocs compatibility vs raw html anchors. maya: updated. replacing HTML anchors with `{#...}` in the PR. alex: i'll queue a quick review. @jen can you take an approve+merge if CI is green? :+1: jen: sure, will check when the linkcheck re-run completes. docs-bot: FYI — consider adding a CI step that parses linkcheck output and posts a short list of offending anchors to the PR as a comment (could reduce dev churn). alex: good idea. created an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/211 — we can follow up with an auto-suggester bot later. maya: after merge i'll run a full mkdocs build for the main branch and watch the site deploy. will report back here with the final status. :eyes: ci-bot: re-run queued: docs/mkdocs linkcheck started for PR 4321... (last) alex: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. marking as in-progress until CI green. :thumbsup:
